_note: The SCHOOL's moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.3 / 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: school:class_teacher, school:pe_teacher (with the creation answer 'A PE teacher spotted you' the one who did: condition origin), school:counsellor (the study counsellor, opo). Shown on the School page of the People tab (user 2026-10-18). Real yläkoulu life in grades 8-9: tests (the moments read SchoolSystem's tests), the Move! fitness measurement of grade 8, the school's cross-country run, the winter sports day, the work-experience week (TET), the joint application with the counsellor, the class trip and the spring party. A `grades` reply nudges the school levels a little; nothing changes what is trained. Grades 8-9 only (lukio staff come in P2).

text: I hear you're training properly at {club} now. Ever since that school cross-country I knew you had it. How is it going?
So the cross-country winner joined a club! I'm glad. Tell me how the training feels.

replies.label: It's great. Thanks for pushing me
replies.result: That makes my week. Keep me posted on your races.

replies.label: Harder than I thought
replies.result: Good things usually are. Hang in there.

text: Your Move! fitness results came back from the autumn. The shuttle run: best in the whole grade. Not a surprise.
The Move! measurements are in. You beat the shuttle run record of the school. The others want a rematch.

replies.label: Nice, I'm happy with that
replies.result: You should be. I'll put it on the wall.

replies.label: It's my sport, so...
replies.result: Still. Let the others have a small chance next time.

text: The schools' cross-country run is next week. Will you run for the school? Everybody expects you to win.
Cross-country day for the school team next Thursday. I've written your name down. In pencil.

replies.label: Of course I'll run
replies.hint: an extra race for your legs
replies.result: Excellent. The trophy has been in the other school's case for too long.

replies.label: I'll ask {coach_first} first
replies.result: Sensible. Let me know by Monday.

replies.label: Not this year
replies.result: Pity. The younger ones look up to you.

text: Winter sports day on Friday. Skiing, skating or the snowshoe trip. What do you choose?
The winter sports day is coming. The 5 km ski race or the skating? Pick one.

replies.label: The ski race
replies.result: Bring your own skis if you have them.

replies.label: Skating with my friends
replies.result: A calm day. Hot juice at the lean-to shelter.

replies.label: The snowshoe trip
replies.result: Quiet forest, sausages on a fire. Not bad for a school day.

text: The primary school sports day is next week. Could you help me with the running events? The little ones would love it.
I need a few big pupils to run the relay station at the 3rd graders' sports day. Are you in?

replies.label: Happy to help
replies.result: Twenty eight-year-olds asked for your autograph. True story.

replies.label: I'm too busy
replies.result: No problem. Maybe next year.

text: You looked very tired in class today. Is everything all right? Is the training too much?
You fell asleep in the history lesson. I didn't say anything. But I noticed.

replies.label: Training is heavy right now
replies.result: Thank you for telling me. Get some sleep. And tell your coach too.

replies.label: I'm fine, just a bad night
replies.result: All right. My door is open.

text: Remember the {test_subject} test tomorrow. I know you had practice today, but an hour with the book helps.
{test_subject} tomorrow. Reading the summary pages tonight is enough.

replies.label: I'll read tonight
replies.hint: grades ▲ a little · a late night
replies.result: Good luck tomorrow.

replies.label: I'm ready already
replies.result: Then sleep well.

text: How did the test go today? You finished early. Confident or just done?
I saw you writing until the last minute. How did it feel?

replies.label: It went well
replies.result: Good. Results on Friday.

replies.label: Not great
replies.result: One test is one test. There's always the next one.

text: A busy week: three tests. Make a plan, and don't leave it all to the night before.
This week has a lot of tests. How are you planning to fit it around training?

replies.label: I've made a plan
replies.result: Good. That's half the work.

replies.label: Honestly, I'm stressed
replies.result: Come and see me at lunch. We'll sort it out.

text: If you need to leave early on Friday for {meet}, your parents have to send me a message in Wilma.
Travelling to {meet}? Remember to ask for the homework of the lessons you miss.

replies.label: I'll sort it out
replies.result: Good luck at the race!

replies.label: Oops, I forgot to ask
replies.result: Do it tonight, then.

text: I wanted to say: your report card was really good this time. Sport and school together. Well done.
Your grades went up. I know how much you train. That's impressive.

replies.label: Thank you!
replies.result: Keep it up.

replies.label: It took some late nights
replies.result: Don't overdo it. Sleep matters too.

text: Your grades dropped this term. Can we talk about how to balance school and training?
I'm a bit worried about your report card. Is the training taking too much time?

replies.label: Let's make a plan
replies.result: Good. Tuesday after school, my classroom.

replies.label: I can handle it
replies.result: I hope so. We'll see in the spring.

replies.label: My parents already talked to me
replies.result: Then you know where we all stand.

text: A 10 in PE, of course. But next term I want you to try the ball games properly too.
Your PE grade is the easiest one I give all year.

replies.label: Thanks!
replies.result: Keep the pace up.

replies.label: Ball games, really?
replies.result: Yes, really. Footwork is footwork.

text: Three homework assignments missing this week. I know you train a lot. Can you catch up by Friday?
Your Swedish homework hasn't been done for a while. Is something going on?

replies.label: I'll catch up this week
replies.hint: a late night · grades ▲ a little
replies.result: Thank you.

replies.label: I'm just too busy
replies.result: Busy is no excuse. Talk to me if you need help.

text: Time to choose your TET place: two weeks of work experience in the spring. Any ideas? A sports shop, the club, a kindergarten?
Your TET weeks are coming. Where would you like to try working?

replies.label: The sports shop
replies.result: Good choice. You'll learn about shoes, at least.

replies.label: The club office
replies.result: I'll call {club}. They'll be happy to have you.

replies.label: A kindergarten
replies.result: Lovely. Prepare to be very tired.

text: Grade 9: the year of the joint application. Let's meet in October and talk about your options. Sports lukio, general lukio, vocational?
Hi {name}, I'm booking talks with every ninth grader. You do athletics, I hear. Have you looked at the sports lukio options?

replies.label: I'm interested in a sports lukio
replies.result: Then your grade average matters. Most need at least 7-7.5. We'll look at your grades.

replies.label: A general lukio, I think
replies.result: A good plan. We'll check the averages they asked for last year.

replies.label: No idea yet
replies.result: That's normal. That's why we talk.

text: Your average is close to the limit for the sports lukiot. This spring's grades count. Can you push a bit?
About the application: your sport points look good, but the grade average could decide it. Let's talk.

replies.label: I'll push this spring
replies.result: Good. Focus on the subjects where you are close to the next grade.

replies.label: What's my backup?
replies.result: A general lukio here, and you keep training with your club. Many do.

text: The joint application is open! Up to seven wishes, best first. Have you made your list on the School page?
Reminder: the application window is open now. Put the place you want most first, not the one you think you'll get.

replies.label: Working on it
replies.result: Good. Ask me if you're unsure about the order.

replies.label: Can you check my list?
replies.result: Of course. Bring it on Wednesday.

text: The class trip! We're thinking of two days in Tallinn, or a day at Linnanmäki. You get a vote.
The class trip money from the kiosk sales is enough for an overnight trip. Vote: Tallinn or a cottage weekend?

replies.label: Tallinn!
replies.result: Tallinn won. The ferry, the old town, and nobody slept.

replies.label: A cottage weekend
replies.result: Sauna, the lake, and the whole class together one last time.

text.text: The spring party is on Saturday. Then summer. You've done well this year. See you in August.
Your last spring party at this school. I've enjoyed having you in my class. Remember us when you're famous.

replies.label: Thank you for everything
replies.result: Have a wonderful summer.

replies.label: Summer, finally!
replies.result: Ha! Enjoy it.

text: Your group's history project is due on Friday. The others say they can only meet on Thursday evening. Can you be there?
The biology group work: your group is waiting for your part. Thursday evening, the library?

replies.label: I'll be there
replies.hint: a late night · grades ▲ a little
replies.result: The project got done. Mostly by you, the others say.

replies.label: I'll do my part online
replies.result: Fine, as long as it's on time.

replies.label: I have training
replies.result: Your group will not be pleased.

text: The Swedish oral exam is next week. Five minutes about your hobby. Easy for you: talk about running!
Oral Swedish next week. Prepare a short talk about something you love. I wonder what you'll pick.

replies.label: I'll prepare properly
replies.result: "Jag springer 800 meter." Your teacher looked very pleased.

replies.label: I'll improvise
replies.result: You said 'löpning' eleven times. It went fine. Mostly.

text: Floorball tournament in PE next week. You're one of the captains. Pick your team wisely.
Next week in PE: the orienteering course round the school. I'd like you to set it with me. Interested?

replies.label: Sounds fun
replies.result: Good. The others already know who they want to be with.

replies.label: Do I have to?
replies.result: Yes. PE is still a school subject.

text: Your class teacher said you look tired and stressed. Do you want to come and talk? No forms, just talking.
Hi, I'm checking in with some pupils who have a lot going on. My door is open on Wednesdays.

replies.label: Yes, I'd like that
replies.result: Wednesday at twelve. We'll look at your week together.

replies.label: I'm OK, thanks
replies.result: All right. The offer stands.
